name: HPS Investment Partners and Arcmont Asset Management
note: Joint owners of Dainese S.p.A. since January 2026 (100% of shares, per MCN, 29 Jan 2026). Reporting of October 2025 described a debt-for-equity swap by creditors HPS and Arcmont after Carlyle's exit; HPS's acquisition by BlackRock was also reported, but no quotable primary statement of the group's own ownership was collected here.
